_doc: Recipe lanes: a model (by its library id) that is played by its own start/stop scripts instead of Ollama / vLLM / SGLang. The deck still enforces the guard: one GPU engine at a time, need_gib checked, everything it would stop named, Ollama never stopped for you. start/stop run with MCC_MODEL_DIR, MCC_MODEL_ID, MCC_PORT and 'env' set; '{model_dir}' in env values becomes the local copy path. copy:false = the recipe keeps its own weights (INSERT only starts it).
